description: Stationnements vélo is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération Gaillac Graulhet. Fichier CSV UTF8 avec l'ensemble des stationnements vélo du territoire de la Communauté d’Agglomération Gaillac Graulhet, données issues de levés terrain effectués en 2026. Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération Gaillac Graulhet. The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'Agglomération Gaillac Graulhet. Its keywords include stationnement-cyclable, stationnement-velo, plan-velo. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-03-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
